title: Window
move: Move window with arrow keys; Shift uses a 1 pixel step

resize.n: Resize top edge with arrow keys
resize.s: Resize bottom edge with arrow keys
resize.e: Resize right edge with arrow keys
resize.w: Resize left edge with arrow keys
resize.ne: Resize top right corner with arrow keys
resize.nw: Resize top left corner with arrow keys
resize.se: Resize bottom right corner with arrow keys
resize.sw: Resize bottom left corner with arrow keys
